_comment: Tightened from defaults. max_price 50 and min_volume 500k target the small-cap explosive universe. min_relative_volume 2.0 requires stocks already showing above-normal activity. Model-driven thresholds (hv10, rsi) will be auto-populated by ml_track_comprehensive_accuracy.py after enough prediction history accumulates. min_market_cap/max_market_cap are null (no bound) by default — set them (e.g. max_market_cap: 2000000000 for small-cap only) to constrain the non-winners pool by market cap; applied consistently across the TradingView screener and yfinance fallback paths for both winners exclusion and non-winners detection.
